title: Graph Neural Network-Based Reinforcement Learning for Controlling Biological Networks - the GATTACA Framework
abstract: arXiv:2505.02712v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Cellular reprogramming, the artificial transformation of one cell type into another, has been attracting increasing research attention due to its therapeutic potential for complex diseases. However, identifying effective reprogramming strategies through classical wet-lab experiments is hindered by lengthy time commitments and high costs.   In this study, we explore the use of deep reinforcement learning (DRL) to control Boolean network models of complex biological systems, such as gene regulatory and signalling pathway networks. We formulate a novel control problem for Boolean network models under the asynchronous update mode, specifically in the context of cellular reprogramming. To solve it, we devise GATTACA, a scalable computational framework. translated_title: 基于图神经网络的强化学习用于控制生物网络——GATTACA框架
translated_abstract: 细胞重编程，即将一种细胞类型人工转化为另一种细胞类型，因其对复杂疾病的治疗潜力而日益受到研究关注。然而，通过传统的湿实验室实验来识别有效的重编程策略受到耗时长、成本高的阻碍。在本研究中，我们探索使用深度强化学习（DRL）来控制复杂生物系统（如基因调控网络和信号通路网络）的布尔网络模型。我们在异步更新模式下为布尔网络模型提出了一个新颖的控制问题，特别是在细胞重编程的背景下。为了解决这一问题，我们设计了GATTACA，一个可扩展的计算框架。为了提高框架的可扩展性，我们采用了先前提出的伪吸引子概念，并改进了有效识别伪吸引子的流程。
tldr: 本文提出GATTACA框架，将图神经网络与深度强化学习相结合，通过控制布尔网络模型高效求解细胞重编程控制问题，并借助改进的伪吸引子识别方法实现可扩展性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes GATTACA, a scalable framework combining graph neural networks and deep reinforcement learning to control Boolean network models for cellular reprogramming, enhanced by an improved pseudo-attractor identification procedure.
